entries.title: Psalms 148:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Praise Jehovah from the heavens; praise him in the heights.

entries.title: Psalms 148:2
segments: Praise ye him, all his angels; praise ye him, all his hosts.

entries.title: Psalms 148:3
segments: Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all ye stars of light.

entries.title: Psalms 148:4
segments: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:5
segments: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, for he it is that commanded, and they were created:

entries.title: Psalms 148:6
segments: And he established them for ever and ever; he made [for them] a statute which shall not pass.

entries.title: Psalms 148:7
segments: ¶Praise Jehovah from the earth, ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

entries.title: Psalms 148:8
segments: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, stormy wind fulfilling his word;

entries.title: Psalms 148:9
segments: Mountains and all hills, fruit-trees and all cedars;

entries.title: Psalms 148:10
segments: Beasts and all cattle, creeping things and winged fowl;

entries.title: Psalms 148:11
segments: Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 148:12
segments: Both young men and maidens, old men with youths, --

entries.title: Psalms 148:13
segments: Let them praise the name of Jehovah: for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above the earth and the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 148:14
segments: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, [even] of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Hallelujah!
